intent: Choose one or several options from a list. Field trigger, kit DropdownMenu panel. Not a native select.
useWhen: Choosing one value in a Field
Choosing several values from a list (multiple)
A long fixed list with local search (searchable)
Short fixed lists such as month, year, timezone, or tags
doNotUseWhen: Actions from a button — use DropdownMenu
Mutually exclusive choices with visible options — prefer RadioGroup

multiple.note: Several values. Menu stays open. Checks each pick. Trigger lists labels. Not a MultiSelect cousin.

placeholder.note: Shown until a value is picked. Muted field text. When set and no defaultValue, start empty.

defaultValue.note: string when single, string[] when multiple

ariaLabel.note: When there is no Field label, such as a DataTable Cell.

itemCheck.note: checkbox composes kit Checkbox in the menu when multiple. Visual only. Not DropdownMenuCheckboxItem.

maxVisible.note: When multiple and selected count exceeds this, the trigger shows the first labels (or Tags) plus a kit Badge +N. Omit to show all.

valueDisplay.note: multiple only. text lists labels in the trigger. tags shows each pick as a removable kit Tag (sm Select: Tag sm; md: Tag md) that wraps onto more lines. Removing a Tag deselects that value without opening the menu. maxVisible still caps Tags with the +N Badge.

searchable.note: Kit Input at the top of the panel. Filters option labels. For a long fixed list. Not Command.

requirements: Trigger is a field-styled button with aria-haspopup=menu
Must have associated label via Field or ariaLabel
Each option needs a human-readable label
Selected options show a Check, or kit Checkbox when itemCheck=checkbox
Overflow count is kit Badge on the trigger
valueDisplay=tags: Tags are siblings of the trigger button, never inside it (no nested buttons). Each Tag remove is its own button labelled Remove {label}
valueDisplay=tags: Tab order is each Tag remove button, then the trigger. Removing a Tag moves focus to the next remove button, or the trigger after the last one. Backspace does not remove Tags

doNot: Do not use a native select
Do not use kit Button as the Select trigger — Select uses DropdownMenu triggerStyle=field
Do not invent SelectTrigger, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectValue, SelectGroup, MultiSelect, or Combobox
Do not invent a local overflow chip — overflow count is kit Badge
Do not render Tags inside the trigger button or add a local chip list — use valueDisplay=tags
Do not use for navigation — use AppNav or links
snippet:
<Field label="Fruit" htmlFor="fruit">
  <Select id="fruit" placeholder="Select a fruit" options={[{ value: 'apple', label: 'Apple' }]} />
</Field>
<Select id="fruits" multiple itemCheck="checkbox" maxVisible={2} placeholder="Select fruits" options={fruits} />
<Select id="city" searchable placeholder="Select a city" options={cities} />
<Select id="teams" multiple valueDisplay="tags" maxVisible={2} placeholder="Select teams" options={teams} />
